text:
nina: Heads-up — I'm starting the work to wire up private/VPC on-prem telemetry export for runtime metrics. We need alignment across eng-platform, security, and infra on egress firewall rules, KMS envelope flow, per-customer quota hooks in the Console, and the dashboard metrics contract. Who can jump in?

rafael: I can take ownership of the runtime metric names and the protobuf/JSON schema. Can we list the exact fields we need? also: are we doing push (agent->redwood collector) or pull (redwood pulls from agent)?

jamie: eng-platform preference is push from agent to a customer-configurable bridge endpoint that we manage for hosted customers, and for private we can support a local sink that pushes to customer's S3/HTTP. For the short term, propose: agent pushes to collector over TLS to a single FQDN and we document IP ranges for firewall allowlist.

sasha: Security note: telemetry MUST be envelope-encrypted before leaving customer network. Agent should call customer's KMS (or customer-provided CMK) to encrypt data key, then use that to encrypt payload locally. We need key-usage audit events forwarded to our audit pipeline. Also need to confirm we don't keep plaintext logs on the agent. :lock:

leo: I ran a quick test yesterday. Firewall whitelist we used in the lab: 52.23.45.0/24 and 18.194.0.0/16 for collector frontends. But we should avoid hardcoding IPs — publish an ASN + FQDN and support DNS-based allowlists. Also note some on-prem proxies require SNI match.

jamie: Proposed minimal firewall snippet for docs:```
# outbound from agent
ALLOW TCP 443 to collector.telemetry.redwood-internal.net (SNI required)
# optional: health checks to 10.0.0.0/8 for local infra
```

rafael: Metric names proposal (runtime emits):
- telemetry.runtime.metrics_sent_count
- telemetry.runtime.bytes_sent
- telemetry.runtime.kms_encrypt_calls
- telemetry.runtime.export_errors_total{reason}
- telemetry.runtime.bandwidth_bytes_total
I recommend counters + tags for customer_id, deployment_mode (onprem/vpc/dedicated), region. Keep names stable.

sasha: For KMS audit hooks: agent should emit an audit event each time it requests a data key from the customer's KMS (include key id, operation=Encrypt, timestamp). These events should be optionally forwarded to the customer's SIEM and to our secure audit sink (metadata only, no plaintext payload).

nina: @rafael @jamie can you confirm what telemetry fields the Console needs to display quotas and usage? We need per-org token counts, bytes, and last successful upload timestamp. Also a per-org toggle to anonymize exports for compliance.

jamie: Console needs: 
- org.metrics.tokens_used (30d)
- org.metrics.bytes_transferred (30d)
- org.metrics.last_export_ok
- org.settings.export_mode = [full, anonymized, off]
We'll add a quota endpoint to the internal API: GET /internal/orgs/:id/telemetry_quota that returns current usage + limit.

rafael: runtime will expose an internal HTTP endpoint for agent status + current counters to support the console's quota pull. Example: GET /_internal/telemetry/state -> {"tokens":1234, "queued_bytes":0}. We'll document JSON schema.

sasha: Security review checklist: KMS envelope, no keys stored persistently, audit events emitted, TLS 1.3 enforced, mTLS optional for customers who want mutual auth, and key rotation path. Assigning review to me.

leo: Ops note: for rollout we should do canary across 5 internal orgs, then 10 customer orgs, then GA. We'll have an emergency kill-switch on the agent to flip export_mode=off via config push.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created export-handshake job for agent v0.8.2 in staging — job id 9a3f2. :gear:

jamie: I'll open a PR with: metric names, Console API contract, firewall docs, and an initial runbook for on-call. Assign to @sasha + @rafael for review. Can we sync Friday 10:00 PT? :calendar:

nina: Friday 10:00 PT works for me. I'll prepare the agenda: metric contract, KMS flow diagram, firewall + DNS guidance, Console wireframes for quota UX, and rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

rafael: I'll add a sample JSON schema file to the PR and include an example agent payload.

sasha: I'll draft the security checklist and minimum IAM policy snippets for docs. Quick example IAM policy (placeholder):```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/EXAMPLE"
}
```

leo: I'll test the collector SNI behavior and report back before Friday.

nina: Great — thanks everyone. If anyone can't make Friday ping here and we'll record notes.

ops-bot: reminder-bot: meeting scheduled Fri 10:00 PT — channel will be #eng-infra.
